name: spring-tx
description: Spring Framework 7.0.9 transaction management on DataSourceTransactionManager and PostgreSQL JDBC 42.7.14. Writes use PreparedStatement on the connection from DataSourceUtils.getConnection. JdbcTemplate is not used. No Spring Boot. native and pooled are TransactionTemplate. declarative and declarative-pooled are @Transactional through a JDK proxy and TransactionInterceptor. Category C faults are a client-side injection in this process, fired once, before pgjdbc sends. TX-03 runs only in the pooled modes.

modes.description: Programmatic TransactionTemplate on DataSourceTransactionManager over DriverManagerDataSource. No pool. The outer template uses the default PROPAGATION_REQUIRED. A nested scope uses PROPAGATION_NESTED. An independent inner transaction uses PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW, which opens a second physical connection. The explicit isolation case uses PlatformTransactionManager.getTransaction and commit. TX-03 is not run in this mode: DataSourceTransactionManager.doCleanupAfterCompletion releases the connection, and DriverManagerDataSource closes it, so a later unit cannot be handed that connection.

Declarative @Transactional on the same DataSourceTransactionManager and DriverManagerDataSource. The adapter calls a JDK proxy advised by TransactionInterceptor. It does not call the target directly. Nested work is a second call on that proxy, with PROPAGATION_NESTED or PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW. The default rollback rule is RuntimeException and Error. TX-03.statement-error-rollback-not-sent is not in this mode. TX-05.explicit-serializable is not in this mode: @Transactional does not return a transaction handle.

Programmatic TransactionTemplate. HikariCP 7.1.0 with maximumPoolSize 1. No other pool setting is changed. Between the two units the connection is released through Spring's normal path. The pool is not closed, the connection is not evicted, and no validation query is issued between them. TX-03 runs only in this mode and in declarative-pooled.

Declarative @Transactional through TransactionInterceptor, on HikariCP 7.1.0 with maximumPoolSize 1. No other pool setting is changed. The statement-error case uses rollbackFor = Exception.class so the checked SQLException takes the rollback path the case describes. The default rule, which does not roll back a checked exception, is not used for that case.
